purpose: One bounded feasibility probe of an official MIT OCW discovery route, not a course-search acceptance rerun
transport: Existing Fetcher.fetch and PinnedHTTPClient; fresh public A/AAAA validation by existing fixed Cloudflare DoH resolver; TLS hostname and pinned public IP; trust_env=false; no browser or JS execution
selection_rule: Start only from entry_url, letting Fetcher retrieve and enforce same-origin robots first.
Stop on HTTP/access/DNS/timeout/size error; no replacement path or repeated failed request.
Parse returned HTML offline for actual course links, public GET search forms and structured declarations; never guess an API or request script assets.
If a same-origin public GET search form exposes a named search input, issue at most one eigenvectors query using that observed action and parameter. Do not reuse held-out topics.

Otherwise, if robots actually declares a same-origin sitemap URL, fetch only the first declared sitemap once, subject to robots and remaining budget. Do not recursively follow sitemap indexes or guess sitemap paths.
Do not fetch discovered course pages or media, follow unreviewed third-party endpoints, seed results, modify production code/configuration, or access SQLite.
doh_budget_authorization: Parent explicitly clarified: at most 4 target HTTP plus at most 12 separately recorded DoH HTTP, at most 16 actual HTTP total, all sequential.
output: mit-discovery-probe.json with request UTC/status/error/body-read/hash/truncation evidence and separate counts; successful raw target bodies retained alongside it
